notes.title: Game Update v5.0.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Battles of the Ancient World Version 3.0.2 Update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Battles of the Ancient World v3.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Improved game logic for advance after combat. Units will more often advance after combat if the target hex has been vacated.
[*] Change: Reduced the size of some background images.
[*] Change: Improved repsponsiveness of some text based buttons.
[*] Fix: An issue that some countries flags and related images did not appear.
[*] Fix: An issue with the image scaling of SD images.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.Fix: Incorrect fonts showing for some button text.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
There are a few fixes in this patch.

Fix: Some units not moving when triggered.
Fix: Some generals not moving with their chariots.
Fix: Munda scenario: Showing defeat screen after victory.
Fix: Enemy loss meter not moving.
Fix: Moving general out of a unit would allow that unit to attack again.

If you notice any issues please email support@hexwar.com
